name: todocky
title: Todocky
description: Add tasks to your Todocky board without leaving Raycast.
author: yuno

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.subtitle: Todocky
commands.description: Create a task in a Todocky project, picking the project from a list.

commands.name: quick-add-task
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.subtitle: Todocky
commands.description: Create a task in your default Todocky project straight from the Raycast bar.

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.subtitle: Todocky
commands.description: Browse Todocky projects and add a task to any of them.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Todocky Server URL
preferences.description: The MCP server URL shown in Todocky under Settings → MCP Server.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Only needed when Todocky runs on another Mac with "Allow network access" on. Generate it in Todocky under Settings → MCP Server → Tokens.

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Project name used by Quick Add Task. Leave empty to use the last project you added to, or Inbox.
